role: Fresh independent A informed science on exactly two current whole HE assessments, with actual 185/265 admission lists. Frozen before formal output serialization.
reviewer: Independent A; nonauthor; no current peer B opinions consulted.

primarySource.actualRead: HE source E4-E6 standards, course differentiation, E.1-E.5 and all Q1.1-Q4.3 course columns; printed pp24,30,35-51. No new native-page vote asserted.

scopeMethod: Read both whole current assessment objects, complete task/solution/rubric/coverage, the 265 unique whole direct prerequisite bodies for admission meaning, and eight supplied current technical scope witnesses. The authored whole-course admission can be legitimate without retesting every prior. Visibility is not official source qualification. This is not a positive separate D/P/A/M/V review of each prior.

findings.reason: The current whole GK gate requires operators placed in HE increased-level columns: half-titration/pK, weak-acid titration curves, coordinate bonding in Fehling, manganometry, solubility products, weak-acid/base pH, entropy and Gibbs-Helmholtz. The whole aromatic goal additionally includes nitration: HE halogenation is shared, nitration increased level. Actual planar chromatography is specifically HE Q2.1 increased level; general E4/E5 practical standards do not universally select this particular acquisition for GK. Global GK/LK tags are not HE course identity.
findings.authorAction: Revise the GK list and matching source-qualified scope against complete operators and the actual HE course columns; preserve genuinely shared narrower competencies.

findings.reason: The two BY-specific silicone synthesis/comparison and nanoscale wetting competencies are neither necessary for the ethanol paper nor established as universal HE course targets. HE Q2.2 silver nanoparticles in polyolefin packaging does not establish silicone chemistry. HE Q2.4 specifies PLA/copolymers and increased-level rubber/viscose. The observed HE requires-closure from 145/e560 is applicability evidence, not independent source authority.
findings.authorAction: Remove their universal HE admission claim or establish an explicitly justified broader authored scope; preserve BY goals and their evidence.

findings.decision: REVISE current universal course-target classification; possible LK prior support
findings.reason: TH origin does not invalidate useful prior knowledge. Saturation is a reasonable lower-stage conceptual support for HE-LK solubility equilibria. The actual whole atom also demands amount/capacity reasoning; M1 asks ethanol/ethane miscibility from intermolecular forces, not saturation-capacity calculations. This does not justify a universal HE-GK target. Current HE applicability comes from the assessment requires-closure.
findings.authorAction: Decide explicitly whether to retain justified lower-stage support for LK solubility equilibria. Do not count closure/TH provenance as official HE target evidence or force an unsupported GK completion duty.

findings.reason: The LK list includes independent advanced routines without an established universal HE course/task necessity: O2/N2 MO diagrams and bond order, IR/1H-NMR assignment, Friedel-Crafts planning, Pourbaix construction, quantitative van t Hoff and Kp/Kc conversion, Arrhenius activation-energy determination, mechanisms from rate laws, Michaelis-Menten parameters and statistical distributions. HE carbon hybridization is not O2/N2 MO analysis; HE Nernst concentration cells are not Pourbaix construction; stoßtheorie/RGT is not quantitative Arrhenius/rate-law inference. None is required by the seven actual assessed competencies.
findings.authorAction: Provide a bounded HE target justification or remove the universal admission claim. Generic LK tags and inherited applicability are insufficient.

findings.decision: Needs explicit authored HE scope justification; not approved as universal duties
findings.reason: Detailed medication/digestion/resorption, nucleic-acid, conductive-polymer and electrophoresis competencies can be useful authored content. The actual HE clauses and this paper do not establish all those independent whole operators as universal course prerequisites. HE E.3 ethanol effects and Q1.5 conservation do not create a general pharmacology course; protein properties do not automatically require electrophoresis or genetic resorption differences.
findings.authorAction: Resolve exact authored HE scope and source fidelity. Inclusion of applicable authored topics on 16 October does not erase jurisdiction/course boundaries or make optional official themes universally compulsory.

findings.decision: Explicit source/interface justification needed; no automatic universal HE duty
findings.reason: Both exact NI eA goals require own supervised measurements: calibrated/uncertainty-bounded titration-curve acquisition and a paired buffer/unbuffered experiment. HE E4-E6 supports genuine practical work, and LK Q3.2 supports titration curves; these activities are scientifically compatible. Those broad standards do not by themselves select every NI acquisition protocol as a universal HE admission atom. The written paper performs neither experiment and cannot create their mastery.
findings.authorAction: Establish an explicitly justified HE prior acquisition route or remove blanket course-target admission; preserve valid NI competencies. This is not a finding that HE learners may never perform these activities.
